# Stroke

> Stroke is a native database client for engineers and analysts. Query, browse, and edit every database you run, in one fast app. It runs on macOS, Windows, and Linux, with a built-in MCP server so AI agents can query the same databases.

Stroke connects to PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB, SQLite, DuckDB, SQL Server, ClickHouse, CockroachDB, Turso / LibSQL, and Cloudflare D1. Redis support is in beta. Connections run directly from the user's machine; credentials and query results never pass through Stroke's servers. The full app is free to try with no account. A license costs $9.99 once (2 devices, every future update), and a Team license costs $99 once for everyone on a company email domain. The source is on GitHub.

## Product

- [Home](https://stroke.click/): overview, supported databases, pricing, FAQ
- [Features](https://stroke.click/features): schema explorer, data grid, inline editing, SQL console, exports, diagrams, dashboards, AI chat, MCP server, command palette
- [Pricing](https://stroke.click/pricing): free trial, $9.99 license, $99 Team license, FAQ
- [Weekly giveaway](https://stroke.click/giveaway): one free lifetime license drawn at random every Monday; free to enter with a Stroke account
- [Roadmap](https://stroke.click/roadmap): shipped, in progress, planned
- [Changelog](https://stroke.click/changelog): release notes for every version, with commit links

## Download

- [All platforms](https://stroke.click/download)
- [macOS](https://stroke.click/download/macos): Apple Silicon and Intel .dmg, or `brew install --cask stroke-app/tap/stroke`
- [Windows](https://stroke.click/download/windows): EXE or MSI installer, or Scoop
- [Linux](https://stroke.click/download/linux): AppImage, .deb, .rpm

## Docs

- [Getting started](https://stroke.click/docs): install, connect a database, activate a license, enable MCP
- [MCP for agents](https://stroke.click/docs/mcp): turn on the MCP server and connect Claude Desktop, Cursor, or any MCP client
